name: joedesk
description: JoeDesk paper-trading dashboard and inbox server

scripts.check: node scripts/check-release.mjs && node scripts/check-package.mjs && node scripts/check-joe-ui.mjs && node scripts/check-fleet-config.mjs && node scripts/check-position-contract.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:ui && npm run test:release && node scripts/run-server-contract.mjs
scripts.test:ui: node --test --test-concurrency=2 test/ui-modules.mjs test/status-line.mjs test/performance-glance.mjs test/phone-first-screen.mjs test/results-model.mjs test/settings-model.mjs
scripts.test:browser: node scripts/browser-p3.mjs && npm run test:results && node scripts/browser-p5.mjs && node scripts/browser-p6.mjs
